_comment: Fragment copy, pinned to a version. The visitor-facing text is ASSEMBLED from these fragments and the site's PUBLIC_TRACKING_VENDORS list (lib/consent-vendors.ts), so each site names exactly the tools it runs. consent_log.consent_text_version = '<version>.<sorted vendors>' — together with Git history that reproduces what the visitor read (GDPR Art. 7(1)). NEVER EDIT IN PLACE: a copy change is a new version directory and a re-consent trigger. Tone: benefit first, factual, no promises. Accept and Reject stay pixel-identical (unit-tested).

banner.title: Help us improve this site
banner.lead: We always use the cookies the site needs to work.
banner.analytics: With your permission we also use {list} to see which pages help visitors and where they get stuck.
banner.none: We do not use any other cookies.
banner.transfer: Some of this data is processed by {orgs} in the United States.

panel.title: Cookie settings
panel.intro: You can decide per category and change your mind at any time with the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of every page.

necessary.label: Strictly necessary
necessary.body: Required for the site to work at all (security, forms, remembering your cookie choice). We do not ask permission for these, because without them the site cannot be used.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.body: How visitors use the site: which pages are useful and where people get stuck. Tools: {list}.
analytics.none: We do not use analytics cookies.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.body: Measuring whether our advertising brings enquiries. Tools: {list}.
marketing.none: We do not use marketing cookies.

_copy_rules: FORBIDDEN: “if you reject, no data goes to any third party” — false under advanced Consent Mode.
FORBIDDEN: “you won't get irrelevant ads” — a promise, not a fact.
REQUIRED: third parties BY NAME — the fragments are filled from lib/consent-vendors.ts, never “our partners”.
REQUIRED: the US transfer sentence whenever a listed tool transfers to the US.
Benefit-framed and human, never a threat or a guilt trip.
